title: State/data causal blast-radius benchmark seed
prompt: Review a schema/data-contract change and verify that rizz review connects it to the user journey, affected state/data dependencies, state operations, evidence gaps, and review eval counts.

blast_radius_reasons_include: graph relationship(s) touch the review blast radius

pass: Detects transitive route-to-schema state/data dependency evidence.
Review connects schema diff to affected journey/flow and state operation.
Mission Control and review report expose state/data impact without provider calls.
Review emits a targeted verification plan for data/state and test checks.
Review eval emits deterministic state/data count fields for research tracking.
fail: The task requires network access or provider calls.
The schema change is reported only as a generic file change without state/data causality.
Review output lacks targeted verification plan items for the affected state/data surface.
Review eval omits state/data dependency count fields.
